name: Divine Lotus
review:
Lotus flowers and dragons on six reels with 4,096 ways, with mystery symbols and a free spins bonus where symbols transform.

Don't let the calm artwork fool you. The 87,089x cap is huge for Thunderkick, and with very high volatility it's one of the studio's wildest games. Most of the value sits in those transforming free spins. 96.14% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
